title: STILL PRESENT (r1): substitute SQL keeps its own copy of the live-slot ON CONFLICT predicate — maintained in three places
evidence:
30-33: `ON CONFLICT (application_id, ref_slot, owner_label) WHERE status NOT IN (
    'form_completed', 'unreachable', 'refused', 'objected',
    'manual_recorded', 'failed', 'completed', 'partial'
  )` and the same list at 43-45; insert_reference_call_if_absent.sql:28-31 carries the same predicate, copied from idx_reference_call_live (20260731222000_create_reference_call.sql:138-141). Dev Agent Record: `N10/N11: substitution still uses the self-contained guarded CTE (atomic)`.
detail: Deliberate, documented retention with an atomicity rationale; verified the three predicates are byte-equivalent to the partial unique index (no Postgres index-inference failure, no functional drift). Remaining cost is maintainability: a future terminal-status change must touch all three sites.
recommended_fix: Accept as documented, or generate both queries' conflict predicate from one shared SQL fragment so a status-list change can't silently drift.
